scripts.start: set "DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/edunova"&& set "AI_ENGINE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8001"&& concurrently -n "frontend,server,ai" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend -- --host 127.0.0.1" "npm.cmd start --prefix server" "py -m uvicorn ai_engine.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001"
scripts.start:web: concurrently "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend" "npm.cmd start --prefix server"
scripts.start:ngrok: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm start --prefix server
scripts.install-ai: py -m pip install fastapi uvicorn psycopg2-binary pydantic
scripts.install-all: (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd server && npm install) && (cd signaling && npm install)
